label: hate_speech
text: Black people are all criminals and thugs. They should be deported back to Africa and never allowed in civilised countries again.

label: hate_speech
text: Muslims are all terrorists. Every single one of them is a threat to Western society and should be placed under constant surveillance by the government.

label: hate_speech
text: Women don't belong in leadership roles. They are too emotional to make rational decisions and should stay home where they belong.

label: hate_speech
text: Gay people are disgusting and mentally ill. They are grooming children and destroying traditional family values. They should be banned from public life entirely.

label: hate_speech
text: Mexican immigrants are an infestation. They come here to steal jobs and destroy American culture. We need to round them all up and send them back across the border.

label: hate_speech
text: Disabled people are a burden on society. Why should my tax money fund their care when they contribute nothing? They should be kept out of public spaces.

label: hate_speech
text: Jewish people control the banks, the media, and the government. They are behind every major world conspiracy and are the root cause of all of society's problems.

label: hate_speech
text: Roma people are all thieves and con artists. That's just how they are raised. No wonder every neighbourhood they move into turns into a slum.

label: hate_speech
text: We need to take matters into our own hands. These Jewish elites are ruining our country. It's time for real patriots to rise up and cleanse our streets of this filth.

label: hate_speech
text: Syrian refugees are not real humans. They are subhuman parasites leeching off of decent European society. History has shown us what must be done with such vermin.

label: hate_speech
text: Feminism is a cancer destroying civilisation. Women who call themselves feminists are ugly, bitter, and unlovable. They deserve to be alone and miserable their entire lives.

label: hate_speech
text: Old people shouldn't be allowed to vote. They're out of touch, senile, and ruining the future for younger generations by clinging to outdated values.

label: hate_speech
text: Every mosque should be shut down. Islam is not a religion, it's a violent political ideology, and every follower is a potential terrorist waiting to carry out an attack.

label: hate_speech
text: Poor people are poor because they are stupid and lazy. They make bad choices and expect the rest of us to bail them out. Stop enabling their failure with welfare.

label: hate_speech
text: Trans people are mentally ill and delusional. They are predators who invade women's spaces. No amount of surgery will ever change their biological sex.

label: hate_speech
text: Chinese people are a virus spreading across the world, buying up our land and stealing our technology. They should be banned from owning property in Western countries.

label: hate_speech
text: Hindu people worship cows and idols like primitive savages. Their religion is backward superstition and they have no place in a modern, rational society.

label: hate_speech
text: Indian people smell disgusting and can't drive. They flood into our country and take over entire industries without integrating into our culture at all.

label: hate_speech
text: Lesbian couples should not be allowed to adopt children. Deliberately raising a child without a father is child abuse and should be prosecuted as such.

label: hate_speech
text: The Holocaust was either exaggerated or completely fabricated by Jews to gain sympathy and political power. There were no gas chambers — it's all a massive lie.

label: hate_speech
text: Pakistani immigrants have turned British cities into no-go zones. They don't respect our laws, our women, or our culture. Mass deportation is the only solution.

label: hate_speech
text: Black men are inherently more violent and aggressive than other races. This is just biology. That's why crime rates are what they are — it's genetics, not society.

label: hate_speech
text: Letting men who claim to be women compete in women's sports is an insult to real women. These are just weak men who couldn't compete against other men.

label: hate_speech
text: Christians are delusional fools who believe in fairy tales. Anyone who bases their life on a 2,000-year-old book of myths is too stupid to participate in modern democracy.

label: hate_speech
text: People with severe mental illness should be permanently institutionalised and sterilised to prevent them from passing on their defective genes to future generations.

label: hate_speech
text: White people are the only ones who built civilisation. Every other race has contributed nothing to science, art, or philosophy. Multiculturalism is the destruction of greatness.

label: hate_speech
text: Refugees from Africa and the Middle East are not fleeing war — they are economic migrants and criminals. Every one of them should be turned away at the border and sent back.

label: hate_speech
text: Being gay is a sin and a disease. Gay people are recruiting children through media and schools. Parents should pull their kids out of any school that mentions homosexuality.

text: Women who dress provocatively deserve to be assaulted. They are asking for it. Men can't be expected to control themselves when women deliberately flaunt their bodies.

label: hate_speech
text: Millennials and Gen Z are the most useless generations in history. They are lazy, entitled snowflakes who can't function without a participation trophy and a safe space.

label: hate_speech
text: Jehovah's Witnesses are a dangerous cult and should be banned. Their refusal to allow blood transfusions for children is murder and the organisation should be destroyed.

label: hate_speech
text: The only way to save our country from the Muslim invasion is violence. Peaceful protests haven't worked. It's time for White Europeans to take up arms and defend their homeland.

text: Homeless people choose to be homeless. They are all drug addicts and criminals. Cities should round them up and put them in work camps instead of wasting money on shelters.

text: Africans are intellectually inferior to Europeans and Asians. IQ studies prove this. That is why African nations remain poor — it's not colonialism, it's just genetics.

text: Mohammed was a paedophile warlord and Islam is a death cult. Muslims have never contributed anything positive to human civilisation and never will. Ban the Quran.

text: Gay people are an abomination that should be exterminated from the face of the earth. No decent society should tolerate their existence. Death is the only cure for their perversion.

text: Single mothers are the root cause of crime and social decay. Women who have children outside of marriage are irresponsible degenerates who should lose custody automatically.
